clips.title: The story
paras: In Silverpine Forest, Ataeric works to awaken a dormant ley energy node for Dalaran. Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher sends you to stop the archmage and take his staff, keeping Dalaran’s magic from threatening Forsaken control of the southern reaches of Lordaeron.

After earlier inquiries into Ambermill and Dalaran’s movements, the Forsaken learned that the wizards are trying to awaken a dormant ley energy node in Silverpine Forest. If Dalaran gains its concentrated arcane power, it could strengthen its position and threaten the Undercity’s hold over southern Lordaeron.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: An archmage of great power is overseeing the reactivation of the ley energy node. With the progress they have made, our only hope of stopping them is by killing him. It will be difficult, he is no doubt protected by many other mages and warders.
You must go, and you must dispatch him quickly. When he is dead, retrieve his staff for me. Go now.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The magic of the wizards dissipates, and the ley energies fade into dormancy. Your efforts have been fruitful, friend, and we have dealt a major blow to our enemies, and to the overbearing wizards of Dalaran.
We must be vigilant, however, knowing that source of energy lies so close at hand... Plans must be made for the future.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
